scheme_name: Internship Programme Of The Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (MoEFCC)
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Applicant must be pursuing graduation, post‑graduation or diploma in Zoology, Botany, Law or any subject related to Wildlife Management/Conservation/Protection
Applicant must not be in a regular job in the public or private sector
benefits_summary: Certificate of Internship is issued upon satisfactory completion; no remuneration is provided.
application_link: The Additional Director, Wildlife Crime Control Bureau, 2nd Floor, Trikoot-I, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi - 110066
